name: v3.5.5
body: ## Quick Start ### Non-HA: ```shell kubectl create namespace argocd kubectl apply -n argocd --server-side --force-conflicts -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/argoproj/argo-cd/v3.5.5/manifests/install.yaml ``` ### HA: ```shell kubectl create namespace argocd kubectl apply -n argocd --server-side --force-conflicts -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/argoproj/argo-cd/v3.5.5/manifests/ha/install.yaml ``` ## Release Signatures and Provenance All Argo CD container images are signed by cosign. A Provenance is generated for container images and CLI binaries which meet the SLSA Level 3 specifications. See the [documentation](https://argo-cd.readthedocs.io/en/stable/operator-manual/signed-release-assets) on how to verify. ## Release Notes Blog Post For a detailed breakdown of the key changes and improvements in this release, check out the [official blog post](https://blog.argoproj.io/argo-cd-v3-0-release-candidate-a0b933f4e58f) ## Upgrading If upgrading from a different minor version, be sure to read the [upgrading](https://argo-cd.readthedocs.io/en/stable/operator-manual/upgrading/overview/) documentation. ## Changelog ### Bug fixes * 3295d0cede4438315f1f42b019f7d9197a236d80: fix(ci): use curl in kustomize checksum helper so Renovate can refresh checksums (cherry-pick #29938 for 3.5) (#30100) (@argo-cd-cherry-pick-bot[bot]) * a32fb960058cb1676615987058ff20aec5f99f81: fix(hydrator): retry notes push on cannot lock ref errors (cherry-pick #28469 for 3.5) (#29905) (@argo-cd-cherry-pick-bot[bot]) * f0f6bdea7090f2ab188ab3f379aa56ed2670be58: fix(reposerver): stale manifests and goroutine leak after CMP failure (#29870) (cherry-pick #29874 for 3.5) (#30140) (@argo-cd-cherry-pick-bot[bot]) * 3d31f1a9bbef941f0149d3270d5fb3dcd93790fe: fix(server): fill event count and timestamps for events.k8s.io events (#30015) (cherry-pick #30017 for 3.5) (#30111) (@rickbrouwer) * 33a47a550daf4ae407baf04f678a4b5918cb8069: fix(ui): show enableOCI only for Helm (cherry-pick #29974 for 3.5) (#30074) (@argo-cd-cherry-pick-bot[bot]) * a48be5aa0a2d89988be52bb817e7498f7c248947: fix: cache the OCI tag list (#30117) (cherry-pick #30118 for 3.5) (#30119) (@argo-cd-cherry-pick-bot[bot]) * ebf5ac7ff31f1dd6511cc0246e13da4de8125743: fix: correct scheduled-time format in CronWorkflow create-workflow action (#29915) (cherry-pick #29916 for 3.5) (#29953) (@argo-cd-cherry-pick-bot[bot]) * 514141dab1058d72c4bfa4f0f08b63a0a6c1ad14: fix: fix escaped URL routing for write repo (creds) endpoints (cherry-pick #29940 for 3.5) (#29958) (@argo-cd-cherry-pick-bot[bot]) * 4d2194b2b8114aa5eb39b41ae12e82676032aae4: fix: fix untar inbound check if dstPath is symlinked (cherry-pick #28881 release-3.5) (#30053) (@blakepettersson) * 4d68ee32ca16d0f8382bf88cd4adc3b6b3e09568:
